title: Qualify uniform time-grid and conservative numerical boundary audits
commitMessage: feat: qualify uniform-series grid audits and close M6 W02 C03 S03

contribution.summary: Qualify explicit finite time-coordinate audits for uniformly sampled differences and complete-window moving means, with typed irregular-time, missing-data, timestamp-resolution and cancellation refusals. Recover one compiled missing-API RED plus 106 GREEN; preserve 594 scientific tests, four Math regressions and five isolated SHA-equal preview.10 NuGet consumers. Close S03-T2 R/G/V, T2 and S03 only; retain original C03, M6-W02 and M6 open.
contribution.value: Require finite monotonic sample times agreeing with caller-declared interval within a conservative 1e-10 ratio; screen poorly resolved timestamps, tiny nonzero adjacent differences and signed mean cancellation at 1e-12. Heuristics are not certified error bounds; no inferred physical units, derivatives, forecasting, interpolation or irregular resampling.
debtChanges: Observe one independently compiled reflection RED for the missing uniform time-grid audit API before staging source; compiler failure is not RED evidence.
Recover RED and pass 106 GREEN checks for declared interval, finite strictly increasing time coordinates, valid complete-window means and typed refusals.
Reject missing/mismatched/nonfinite/decreasing/irregular time coordinates; do not invent absent values, interpolate, resample or forecast.
Classify relative timestamp resolution below 1e-12 and declared interval deviations above 1e-10 conservatively, without numerical error theorem.
Classify tiny nonzero adjacent differences and signed moving-mean cancellation below 1e-12 while keeping qualified T1 direct API unchanged.
Preserve 61 S03-T1, 69 S02-T2, 60 S02-T1, 53 S01-T2, 25 S01-T1 and 326 prior C01/C02 tests plus four Math regression projects.
Pack and inspect one actual local preview.10 scientific net10 NuGet archive, nuspec identity, byte count and SHA-256 with no unadmitted dependencies.
Independently restore five pinned source-free eight-probe consumers from one cleared local feed into distinct caches; require identical package SHA and bytes.
Keep caller-managed time-coordinate units and input size/budget limits explicit; no geospatial, FFT, forecast, derivative or OS-wide portability claim.
Close only S03-T2-R/G/V, S03-T2 and S03; original C03 aggregate T1/T2, M6-W02 and M6 stay unfinished.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS098 success, prepare RS099 for original M6-W02-C03-T1 aggregate acceptance across separately qualified S01 Euclidean, S02 direct signals and S03 uniform-series contracts, with independent cross-family oracles and source-free NuGet. Keep original aggregate T2 and C03 open.
